people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: These were heads of fathers' houses throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt in Jerusalem.
